Current assessment — 2026-10-05

Reviewed against local main 7057a8d5a2d898c1bfb528a28f3f635dda639b8b, origin/main 568ce108 (local main clean, 112 ahead/0 behind at audit; no push).

Where we are: M0-M3 foundation and M4.01-.05 are closed in the live graph. PR16 and PR18 engineering work is on current main; Multivar is pinned to published ab811e2. M4.06/.07 retain PendingFrozenProtocol and M4.08-.10 plus all M5/final gates remain open.

Fresh context: Yes: scientific milestone continuation.

Next action: Continue frozen inference/randomization/calibration, followed by commensurate group transport and matched scientific/resource evidence. Start from current main and exact published pins; do not redo foundation migrations or infer epic completion from consolidation.

Evidence: docs/verification/umvpa-component-confirmation-20261003.md; docs/verification/umvpa-rank-confirmation-20261002.md; build.sbt; docs/verification/consolidation-20261005.md.

This is a tracker/source/retained-evidence assessment, not a new experiment or test run. Existing acceptance criteria and owner decisions remain binding; dated source-state statements below are superseded where this assessment explicitly corrects them. Status, priority, assignee, claims and dependency edges are unchanged.

---

Previous scope and history (acceptance retained)

Implement ScalaFIM unified analysis from docs/plans/unified-mvpa-prd.md v0.2 and its scientific/architecture/supplementary notes. Planning baseline: e071e83b3a23bc6f304b1e72625d6281d9cfc9ba plus the identified untracked design documents; this is not an assertion that historical candidate APIs are adopted.

Vision: identified evidence + distinct evidence designs + composable measurements + open typed estimands. Predictive fitting and relational geometry share infrastructure without sharing false statistical semantics. The flagship model learns sparse spatially coherent forward patterns, supporting classification, multiresponse encoding/decoding, interpretable rotations, whole-brain and restricted-ROI prediction, Haufe-calibrated patterns, conditional importance, voxel/component/rank confirmation, and commensurate subject/group analysis.

Deliver in six milestone gates: M0 contracts/provider admission/baselines; M1 predictive replacement; M2 operator-native relational replacement; M3 global fit plus foundation cutover; M4 interpretation and confirmation; M5 group and scientific qualification. Child hierarchy is non-blocking containment. Prerequisite edges form the execution DAG; each milestone is blocked by its required deliverables and the epic by the terminal gates. Independent qualification tickets follow implementation tickets.

Hard boundaries: preserve general Gale/Multivar ownership and existing response/locus/estimates infrastructure; use admitted immutable provider pins, Alder lifecycle and resample4s designs; no generic fit -> mvpa dependency, duplicate registries, hidden materialization, or guessed science. New method work must not extend RoiPayload/Response/FoldPlan as universal APIs. Migrate consumers and delete superseded routes per slice; no shipping compatibility layer, with final legacy orchestration removed by M3. Do not infer permission to publish releases, push Git, alter foreign stores, or implement deferred external-engine/group extensions.

Definition of done: all required descendants accepted; three shared-core vertical slices (keyed leave-one-run-out centroid, operator-native crossnobis/RSA, whole-brain structured fit with derived ROI predictor); migrated behavior and JVM/JS parity; no legacy orchestration; scoped voxel/component/higher-rank/group calibration and matched runtime/memory evidence; examples and claim/limitation reports. Numerical, protocol, resource, semantic, and scientific qualification remain separate. M3 permits experimental foundation use; full scientific claims require M4 and M5.

Identification: filter by unified-mvpa, milestone tags umvpa-m0..umvpa-m5, and umvpa-task / umvpa-gate / umvpa-existing. Tickets carry requirements, owned seams, bounded scope, acceptance, verification and dependencies. Mote is the live status/dependency source; docs/plans/unified-mvpa-epic.md will be the reader-facing ID/graph map. No implementation is marked complete by filing this epic.
